text:
maya.marketing: Quick sync 12hr before announce. Need final OK on: stable docs URL, public changelog excerpt (2 bullets), webinar demo time, and staged rollout cadence. Can we lock by 6pm PT?

leo.eng: I can do the redirect once frank gives the final slug. Suggest rollout: 10% @t+20m, 50% @t+2h, 100% @t+7h. Also will add a temporary request rate limit for the first 45m after webinar start.

frank.docs: Draft is at https://internal/docs-staging/feature-telemetry. Final slug request: /docs/feature-telemetry. I'll add a TL;DR and small code sample for the blog.

nisha.product: Webinar ask: 10:30am PT live demo + 15m Q&A. That hits NA morning and EU afternoon. Good?

leo.eng: 10:30 PT works. Will monitor p95 and batch queue. Planning an ops echo channel during the demo.

frank.docs: Adding Known Issues note about token-length edge case and a recommended workaround. Also adding the changelog fragment: 
- Improved telemetry sampling to reduce duplicate traces.
- Fixed SDK retry bug in batched calls.

deploy-bot: changelog publish job passed. artifact=build-601. scheduled publish 2024-10-17T06:15:00Z.

maya.marketing: Great. Recap + owners:
- marketing: announce copy + OG image (maya)
- docs: publish slug + TL;DR + runbook link (frank)
- eng: rollout policy + rate caps + monitoring (leo)
- product: webinar Qs + lead routing (nisha)

maya.marketing: I'll drop the announcement draft in #marketing-drafts in 30m. If infra needs more time for redirects, call it out here. :sparkles:
